```{r}
options(scipen=999)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)

```

```{r}
fatal_police_shootings_data <- read_csv("fatal-police-shootings-data.csv") %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  mutate(date_new = ymd(date))
```
```{r}
fatal_police_shootings_agencies <- read_csv("fatal-police-shootings-agencies.csv") %>% 
  clean_names()
```
```{r}
# Men and woman shot by police since 2015 to sep 4 2020 who had mental illnesses.

fatal_police_shootings_data %>% 
  filter(
    date_new < "2020-09-03"
  ) %>% 
  filter(
    str_detect(gender, "male")|
    str_detect(gender, "female")) %>% 
group_by(gender) %>%
summarise(count = n())

```
gender == "F" | gender == "female",
